item: A start that cannot make its worker thread no longer leaks a download slot, a running import or a queued model
summary: Thread.start() raises RuntimeError (can't start new thread) when the process or machine is out of threads; the Wikipedia dump manager and the OSM region manager had already claimed a slot (status downloading, saved) before launching, so a failed launch left a downloading row with no worker that counted against max_concurrent (3 dumps, 2 OSM regions by default) for the life of the process and made the retry queue behind it, and _pump launched every claimed entry in a row, so the first failure also stranded the entries claimed after it and ended the thread of the download that had just finished. The newsletter folder import said running (in memory and in its saved file) with nothing behind it, the dump index build said running with no worker, and the model pull queue kept the model queued so enqueueing it again returned at already queued and no pump ever ran. Each now takes an Exception from start(): the downloaders say error (class only), give the slot back and go on launching the rest; the import and the index say error; the pull queue takes the model out and records the failure in its history; the error still reaches the caller. 17 tests, 10 red on the old code, 36 of 36 mutants killed. Exception only (R393); stated limits in the shipped log.
